Entry Knighthood Knighthood titles usually come from the traditions of the Seven, investiture rituals, and reputations for martial prowess, and do not automatically imply wealth or kindness. Noble children regard it as the threshold of adulthood, mercenary swordsmen regard it as a rare honor, and many commoners only know whether a knight can defend it when needed. Whether it is valid depends on who can grant the rights, collect the consideration, and actually make the judgment come to fruition in the event of default.
